title: Back Stairs

objectives.note: Lonnie is essential here (he has an Act 3 arc); the mission fails if he dies. Cops among the targets are ordinary killable police (heat only).

objectives.fallback: goto interior.arden_back_stairs with timeLimitSec 90 (timer fail = caught)
objectives.text: Up the Arden fire escape, over the roofs

traversal.at: 8th Ave & W 38th St, the Saturday-night sidewalk
traversal.note: Shoulder through; Brannock bulls through behind.

traversal.at: a garbage-can row at the alley mouth, W 38th St
the Arden's rear fire escape: jump and pull the counterweighted ladder down
the Arden's fire escape, four landings up, past lit windows (an argument; a card game; a radio)
the Arden's parapet to the lower walk-up next door, over a 2 m air shaft
traversal.note: Ledge grab on a near miss.

traversal.at: a water-tank platform, to break line of sight
into the back stairwell bulkhead: the Arden's back stairs
traversal.note: Brannock is too heavy for the gap; he shouts from the far roof.

objectives.traversalMobile: One context button (climb/vault), auto-aligned. No precise timing. A missed roof jump catches the ledge or drops to the fire-escape landing below. The quarry rubber-bands (never more than ~40 m ahead), so no timer fails the player.

objectives.text: Sit at Rita's bar like nothing happened

fail.note: Wasted: retry from checkpoint (hospital flow, Gameplay).
Arrested: retry from checkpoint (booking flow, Gameplay).
Shown as '<Name> died'. Retry from checkpoint; offer a skip after repeated failures.

rewards.payNote: Delphine sells a print of Brannock collecting to a scandal sheet, with no name attached.

mobile: The chase is on foot and solved by route knowledge (M6 taught the back stairs). Brannock is slower than Delphine and loses her at any door with two exits. There's no aiming; the photo auto-frames. Generous break distance.
design: Delphine's power is witnessing. Bauer's arcade is a second safe zone, which seeds his double life. Wurtz is glimpsed in the car, not confronted. COMBAT (26 Nov): see COMBAT table in build_act1_missions.py.
conventions: FEATURE_AUDIT 'Mission conventions': cop kills feed heat only; 'Lose the police' gates on requireNoHeat objectives; fail only for standard reasons.
